newsitem.title: UK: UK M4 grows provisional 10.8 pct in year to Nov.
newsitem.headline: UK M4 grows provisional 10.8 pct in year to Nov.

text.p: The Bank of England published the following data on UK monetary aggregates for November -
Stg M4 lending to banks and b/societies was 7.0 billion stg in Nov.
NOTE - consensus forecasts M4 +10.3 pct yr/yr, M4 lending +5.3 billion stg. * Previously published final figures for M4
The Bank said November's PSBR included a receipt of 900 million stg from the sale of Ministry of Defense married quarters. This scored as negative spending.
Separate intra-group transactions by two banks are estimated to have boosted M4 lending by 0.2 percentage points in November with a positive impact on M4.
